headline: Prep for tonight is complete: the earnings-blackout look's date fix is signed off, and the FWDCAL check, BLKOUT and the earnings-calendar Shadow run after 16:30 ET.
bullets: BLKOUT (earnings-blackout look, descriptive): date fix in and signed off (block-edge trades dropped, no block data; hole selftest passes). Runs tonight after FWDCAL.

New: HKS950 (does a stock's half-hour move repeat in the same half-hour on later days?). Scorer and selftest ready; held until the approved conditions (bar t 2.46, 8-of-11 slots, cost break-even) are in the code and Skeptic re-signs.

Move Hunt 'wrong time' pool: mostly Live arriving after an early move had finished (median move start 09:35, before the owner's 09:50 line), and 22 of 48 were really wrong side. Only what remains after 09:50 gets tested.
Stop widening closed: price path gains nothing (gross t 0.98); the small gain is avoided stop charges, ~0.089R per stop in the 2-year backtest vs ~0.09-0.10R Live, so Live should save about the same.
DIPTURN (owner's dip-then-turn morning, anchored at 09:50): long setups +0.009R/trade, t 0.92 vs 3.57; mirror for shorts negative. Nothing above ~0.045R.
next: Tue 16:30 ET: FWDCAL fresh -> owner PR (four results, stop-widening wording, FWDCAL tier). Wed 11-18: REPS3 + ICCSET, then Scout's shortlist led by the Move-Hunt capture gap.
